mission: Audit-first offline PIT data authority over free sources; no strategy PnL, no S1, no deployment.
invariants: raw_path relative and traversal-free; raw_sha256 lowercase 64-hex
available_time_utc mandatory for scored use; retrieval never substitutes
date-only evidence yields upper-bound availability only, never exact claims
append-only vintages; no overwrite of a filled rank
temporal identity; current symbols never projected backward
PRIMARY/CROSS_CHECK/DIAGNOSTIC roles; no cross-source gap patching
license/entitlement fail-closed; free is not authorized
allowed_actions: read-only discovery of public endpoints (none performed in V1 build)
forbidden_actions: merge to main; push main; force-push; history rewrite; worktree deletion
cherry-pick into asset branches; edit asset state or selection
scored PnL; S1 access; paper/live trading; broker/order operations
credentials; account creation; paid sources; click-through acceptance
committing raw data; strategy implementation; result-aware adoption

asset_adoption_boundaries.CRYPTO_V12: NEVER_ADOPT_V1 - frozen at W12; earliest consumer is V13 under a new owner plan
asset_adoption_boundaries.STOCKS_V4: ELIGIBLE_PRE_FREEZE_ONLY - explicit compatibility cherry-pick before its data/selection freeze; no retrofit after freeze
asset_adoption_boundaries.FOREX_V2: ELIGIBLE_PRE_FREEZE_ONLY - same rule as Stocks V4
asset_adoption_boundaries.verification_note: Boundaries recorded per PLAN_data_fusion.md and commit 1a8b53d (V4/V2 recorded as next-cycle plans; no freeze marker present in the integration tree). Asset worktrees were not modified.

concurrency_contract.rule: never run full pytest concurrently with scored cells, backtests, or large parsing jobs
